a.description: array_like Input data, in any form that can be converted to a masked array. This includes lists, lists of tuples, tuples, tuples of tuples, tuples of lists, ndarrays and masked arrays.

dtype.description: dtype, optional By default, the data-type is inferred from the input data.

order.description: {'C', 'F'}, optional Whether to use row-major ('C') or column-major ('FORTRAN') memory representation. Default is 'C'.
